title: Small Initial Sample Size (4 Episodes)
description: The initial 4-episode evaluation (N=67) had limited statistical power to differentiate fine-grained sequence dynamics.
resolution: Expanded to 7 episodes (E1-E7, N=95) with formal pre-registration, LOEO cross-validation, and power analysis.

title: Cross-Scenario Technique Vocabulary Isolation
description: Technique-level attack patterns exhibit zero repeat transitions across disparate campaigns, causing severe coverage and reachability bottlenecks.
resolution: Quantified via Target Reachability Ceiling (62.11%) and Perfect-Order Prediction Cap (64.98%), formally explaining the performance gap.

title: Episode E5 Sample Imbalance
description: Episode E5 contains only 3 labeled events (2 collapsed transitions), resulting in zero coverage under LOEO cross-validation.
resolution: Conducted full side-by-side sensitivity analysis with E5 removed (6-fold LOEO, N=83) confirming all conclusions hold independently of E5.

title: Artificial Duplicates in Permutation Scheme S2
description: Unconstrained adjacent shuffling in Scheme S2 generated consecutive identical transitions that never occur in collapsed empirical sequences.
resolution: Formally excluded S2 from 7-episode design in pre-registration; adopted Scheme S1 (headline) and Scheme S3 (rejection-sampled constrained shuffle).

title: Speculative Wording in Permutation Test Scripts
description: Reporting scripts included causal speculation regarding adjacency constraints and ambiguous wording on Markov-minus-Frequency rows.
resolution: Neutralized under Amendment 6 to factual difference statistic descriptions and explicit disclaimers regarding hypothesis test boundaries.

title: Synthetic Planted Structure Gate G8 Bound Sensitivity
description: At small sample sizes with V=82, estimator recovery bound for G8 was loose relative to large-sample asymptotics.
resolution: Documented in planted real-scale report; G9 (monotonicity) and G10 (reachability recovery) passed unconditionally.

title: Historical Intermediary A2 Scratch Run Reproducibility
description: Intermediary files from early exploratory 4-episode A2 scratch exploration lacked fixed seeds in exploratory scripts.
resolution: Isolated strictly to early scratch exploration history; all benchmark code, final reports, and baseline hashes are frozen and verified.

title: Absence of Live Operational C3 Metadata in CAM-LDS
description: The open-source CAM-LDS benchmark lacks operational SOC telemetry fields (threat score, investigation priority, asset criticality, CTI confidence, IoCs).
resolution: C4 prediction record and C3 adapter support pass-through with explicit null semantics pending live integration agreement with C3 owner.

title: Real-Time Streaming Ingestion and Dynamic Episode Demarcation
description: Benchmark operates on demarcated retrospective episodes; real-time SOC deployment requires automated session boundary detection and sliding window aggregation.
resolution: Marked as an open research/engineering question in docs/c3_open_questions.md for Stage 3 production deployment.

title: Higher-Order Context Memory ($k \ge 2$ Markov Dynamics)
description: First-order Markov chains only condition on the immediate previous transition state, ignoring multi-step attack history.
resolution: Exploratory analysis showed severe state space sparsity even at order 1; higher-order models require substantially larger cross-enterprise corpora.
